$comment: Username rules shared by the Flask API (validation) and the React app (signup/customize forms and routing). Usernames appear in profile URLs (/<username>), so every top-level route of the web app must be listed in `reserved`. `messages` are the exact error sentences: checks run in the order length, pattern, reserved; {min_length}/{max_length} come from this file and {username} is the trimmed, lower-cased input.
pattern_description: lowercase letters, numbers, - and _; must start and end with a letter or number

messages.length: Username must be between {min_length} and {max_length} characters.
messages.pattern: Username may only contain letters, numbers, hyphens or underscores, and cannot begin or end with a hyphen or underscore.
